overall_goal: Clean up the kitchen, wash utensils and containers, and dispose of packaging materials

goals.description: Retrieve a glass and a glass lid from the cupboards
goals.rationale: The person opens the cupboards to take out a glass and a large glass lid, placing the lid on the kitchen top.

goals.description: Flatten and dispose of the recipe kit box
goals.rationale: The person flattens the empty recipe kit box and throws it into the cardboard recycling bin.

goals.description: Rinse and dispose of the empty coconut milk can
goals.rationale: The person rinses the empty coconut milk can under the tap, pushes the sharp top inside, and throws it into the recycling bin.

goals.description: Check the food in the frying pan and clean the hob
goals.rationale: The person lifts the lid to check the food, adjusts the heat, and removes a bit of food from the hob.

goals.description: Wash and stack the empty plastic tubs from the recipe kit
goals.rationale: The person washes the yellow, green, and pink plastic tubs with a sponge and stacks them together.

goals.description: Dispose of the paper label and the washed plastic tubs
goals.rationale: The person throws the paper label and the stacked plastic tubs into their respective recycling bins.

goals.description: Dispose of plastic packaging and put away the cling film box
goals.rationale: The person puts the cling film box into a drawer and throws a piece of plastic packaging into the soft plastic recycling bin.

goals.description: Wipe the scale and put it away in the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person wipes the kitchen scale with a cloth and places it on the top shelf of the bottom cupboard.

goals.description: Check the can opener and put it away in the drawer
goals.rationale: The person checks if the can opener is clean and places it back into the middle drawer.

goals.description: Scrub the inner and outer parts of the plastic colander
goals.rationale: The person uses a dishwasher brush to scrub the colander parts to remove attached lentils.

goals.description: Rinse the inner part of the colander and rearrange the drying rack
goals.rationale: The person rinses the inner part of the colander under the tap, moves items on the drying rack, and places the inner part on it.

goals.description: Rinse the outer part of the colander and place it on the drying rack
goals.rationale: The person rinses the outer part of the colander under the tap, shakes off the water, and places it on the drying rack.
